title: Straggler on gb10-node-07/gpu2 stalled llama3 pretrain
text: A single rank ran 2.4x the cluster-median step time after a NVLink degraded on the board. Every all-reduce blocked on it and tokens/sec fell 58%. Root cause: degraded NVLink on one GPU. Action: cordoned the GPU and restarted from checkpoint excluding the rank; throughput recovered.

title: ECC errors accumulating on gb10-node-03/gpu5
text: Correctable ECC errors rose over ten minutes, then a double-bit error crashed the job. Root cause: failing HBM stack. Action: drained the node, ran row-remap, RMA'd the GPU. Prevention: alert on first correctable ECC error.

title: Cluster-wide NCCL all-reduce stall from flapping RoCE link
text: nccl_allreduce_ms spiked 6x across all ranks while fabric_rx_gbps halved. Root cause: a flapping RoCE link causing PFC congestion on the top-of-rack switch. Action: drained the port, moved the job off the degraded link.

title: HBM OOM after sequence-length change
text: mem_pct hit 99% on several ranks after a config bumped sequence length. Root cause: activation memory exceeded HBM. Action: enabled activation checkpointing and reduced micro-batch size.

title: Throughput collapse from dataloader regression
text: tokens_per_s fell 45% with sm_util dropping too, so GPUs were input-bound. Root cause: a deploy reduced dataloader workers and the job became storage-bound. Action: rolled back the change and increased prefetch workers.
